subject: Vendor onboarding: PO eligibility and exception for DataSage pilot
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@datasage.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@datasage.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick question on PO requirement for 6-week pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team is excited to kick off the 6-week pilot. Before we schedule the kickoff, our procurement team asked whether Redwood requires a formal purchase order for short pilot engagements under $5k. Historically for pilots we either sign a short SOW or use a PO waiver, but our internal process is slow and could delay the start by 2–3 weeks.

Can you confirm if DataSage can proceed without a PO for this pilot if we complete your onboarding form and provide the SOC2 attestation? If there are any minimum requirements (W-9, vendor W-9, payment terms), please list them and we can attach them to the intake form.

Attached: DataSage_Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf

Appreciate a quick call if easier.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Ops, DataSage Labs
O: +1 (415) 555-0198


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@datasage.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for 6-week pilot

Hi Lena —

Thanks for sending the intake form and SOC2. Short answer: we have two internal paths depending on spend and risk. For pilots under $10k with no data retention beyond ephemeral logs, we can typically approve a no-PO pathway via a documented exception + signed onboarding form. That said, a few items we need before I can confirm:

- Completed vendor intake (we got the form but there are a few missing fields: primary tax ID and payment contact).
- SOC2 attestation (you attached; thank you) and confirmation of data retention policy for the pilot (max retention: 30 days).
- A short email from your procurement lead indicating they accept our standard pilot terms (we can share a one-page pilot addendum).

Karthik & Neha — looping you in to advise on formal sign-off. Karthik, if this looks low risk from a contract perspective can we approve a PO exception and account note? Neha, any finance flags on vendor payments under $10k without a PO?

If helpful I can approve the exception conditionally today and loop Aditya for final procurement entry. Otherwise we can set up a 15-min sync.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Procurement Ops <procurement@datasage.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for 6-week pilot

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks — we can confirm the missing items: attached updated intake with tax ID and payment contact; our procurement lead (CC'd here) approves the pilot addendum. Data retention for the pilot will be 14 days and logs are purged afterwards. We do not have any special invoice requirements — a single invoice at the end of the pilot is fine.

Attached: DataSage_Onboarding_Form_v1_completed.pdf

Let us know what else you need to complete the exception. We prefer to avoid issuing a PO if possible since our PO cycle is only 3–4 weeks.

Regards,
Procurement Ops
DataSage Labs
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Quick question on PO requirement for 6-week pilot

Marissa / team —

Reviewed the completed intake and SOC2 attestation. Given the capped retention (14 days), single invoice under $5k, and vendor's procurement confirmation, I approve a PO exception for this pilot. Conditions for the exception:

1) Onboarding form and SOC2 doc retained in vendor file (Accounting will record as vendor note).
2) Redwood to issue a one-page pilot addendum (I will attach the template) that Lena signs; addendum must include: confirmed retention window, liability cap = existing T&Cs, and invoice due net-30.
3) No automatic auto-renewal; any extension > 6 weeks requires a PO or SOW.

Aditya — please create the vendor record with flag "pilot-no-po-exception" and route final invoice to the shared accounting inbox when submitted. Neha — FYI for payment expectations.

Marissa — you can confirm to DataSage and schedule kickoff once Lena returns the signed addendum. I will add a short note to the HubSpot deal.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood_pilot_addendum_template.docx
